transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I came in because I’m having trouble with eating at night. When I’m alone and I start, it feels like something kind of takes over, and I can’t stop—even when I’m telling myself to put the food away.
After you eat, do you ever make yourself sick or do anything else to try to get rid of the food or keep from gaining weight?
Yeah. After I eat like that, I usually go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. It feels like the only way to undo it, like before the calories really... count, I guess.

latest_inference.note: The patient reported eating large amounts of food at night followed by self-induced vomiting, which is characteristic of Bulimia nervosa. Other eating disorders in the previous list are ruled out based on the described behaviors.

inference_history.note: Initial presentation suggests possible binge-eating disorder given the report of inability to control eating, especially at night. Other eating disorders remain in the differential at this time.
